# SiteHeader

The top bar of a site: brand, primary links and one action.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.SiteHeader` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.SiteHeader />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.SiteHeader"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Site top bar: brand, links, one action; folds to a menu below 760px; includes a skip link.

## Props (SiteHeaderProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `brand` | `React.ReactNode` | Replaces the default AIUX mark and "Aleem". |
| `brandHref` | `string` | @default "/" |
| `links` | `SiteHeaderLink[]` | Primary links; five or fewer. |
| `action` | `React.ReactNode` | The one action, e.g. a small Button. Moves into the menu on phones. |
| `tools` | `React.ReactNode` | Always-visible tools, e.g. ThemeToggle. |
| `sticky` | `boolean` | Pin to the top. @default true |
| `skipTo` | `string \| false` | Target of "Skip to content"; false to omit. @default "#main" |
| `menuLabel` | `string` | @default "Menu" |
| `label` | `string` | aria-label of the nav. @default "Main" |

_Also accepts: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>._
